name: FoldedPaperHeadline
job: A headline printed across a zig-zag folded paper strip that unfolds flat on click or hover, letters straightening with each crease
visitor_action: click or hover to unfold; readable at every stage
motion: spring-driven: facets flatten crease by crease when unfolded and fold back; no scroll link (reduced-motion: static flat strip, no trigger)
art_direction: True 3D accordion facets (CSS 3D, 52deg creases) driven by scroll; flat deep vermilion #b32914 planes, cream #f0e5cf Anton type and ground, black #16120f index numerals, baseline bar and flat tone planes on shaded facets; no gloss
